description: IA-50 c/n 26 (December 1972), served the FAA high command until 1998, retired 1999; installed on the river bluffs in 2005 as a monument to the first Argentine turboprop; unmaintained and vandalised, plaque stolen. Photographed November 2014 and reported April 2020.
aliases: IA50; Guaraní; G-II; GII; c/n 26; IA-50
museum_name: Barranca del Paraná IA-50 Guaraní Monument, Diamante
